hypothesis: A provenance-bound all-source intake with explicit epoch/promotion gating and mandatory material re-entry can preserve contradictions and provenance while preventing stale observations from silently affecting current research state.
strongest_counterhypothesis: A universal intake/re-entry layer adds storage/context/coordination overhead and false materiality; simpler arrival-order or tag-only processing may be sufficient, and adaptive routing may not justify its complexity on real repo workloads.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Enzyme: Incremental View Maintenance for Data Engineering
fresh_external_evidence.delta: Cost-based refresh selection supports adaptive incremental/full strategies rather than dogmatic incrementality.

fresh_external_evidence.title: The Role of Semirings in Incremental View Maintenance
fresh_external_evidence.delta: New June-2026 results show update complexity depends on query/semiring structure; some classes admit constant amortized update time while others have conditional lower bounds.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Consistent Distributed Reactive Programming with Retroactive Computation
fresh_external_evidence.delta: Late/lost distributed source data can require retroactive recovery; checkpoint time-consistency motivates explicit epoch/checkpoint handling.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Provenance Guided Rollback Suggestions
fresh_external_evidence.delta: Incremental provenance can localize failing changes and support rollback, strengthening the case for preserving provenance through live fusion.

fresh_external_evidence.title: Layph: Making Change Propagation Constraint in Incremental Graph Processing by Layering Graph
fresh_external_evidence.delta: Counterevidence against naive locality: small graph changes may propagate globally, so dense invalidation remains a valid route.

result.other_material_pending_interpretation: Two independent material contradiction assessments were intentionally left without reentry receipts; the pending view correctly keeps them OPEN instead of hiding them.

out_of_box_experiment.name: temporal_braid_fault
out_of_box_experiment.design: Interleave a current claim, a later-arriving but older-epoch contradiction, a same-epoch duplicate-provenance observation, a restart boundary and a fresh supersession.
out_of_box_experiment.interpretation: Final state equality hides a transient causal error: arrival-order processing temporarily promotes stale evidence; epoch-aware gating stores it without granting current-state authority.

architecture_delta.unifieddb: Add V10 persistence/projection surfaces for OmniSourceObservation, FusionAssessment, ResearchReentryReceipt, branch receipts and recovery checkpoints.
architecture_delta.claygraph: No new truth-bearing graph schema added; current graph invalidation/receiver surfaces remain derived routing/observability mechanisms.
architecture_delta.rollback: Do not include V10 migration in promoted stack; existing UnifiedDB V9 remains rollback baseline until remote/current-repo replay passes.
